whatThisIs: One receipt, minted by GENESIS's own producer — not by this repository — and verified here as a consumer. It is the fixture half of Stage 0 consumer readiness: the cross-repo half needs a Genesis checkout, this half needs nothing but the bytes below, so it can run in CI on every commit.

provenance.how: PYTHONPATH=<checkout>/scripts/composition; receipt.issue(seed=0x5a*32, kind=aukora-receipt/v3-genesis, aura=7 fields with priorHead, composition=the five-field v1 set). Re-runnable: scripts/stage0-genesis-acceptance.py --genesis <checkout>
provenance.note: The issuer secret is the fixed public constant 0x5a repeated 32 times — written here, worthless, and used only so the fixture carries a real Ed25519 signature that anyone can reproduce. No production key exists in this tree or in that one.

shape.note: Genesis does not emit compositionBase today. That absence is the whole subject of Stage 0: this repository accepts the document anyway, as the named base v1, by the closed legacy rule — and the acceptance is measured by the check beside this file, not asserted.

files.note: Minted by Genesis. Never edited here: every arm that needs a different shape re-signs a copy at run time with the public seed.
PUBLIC key only, derived from the public seed above.

notDone: Genesis is not modified, imported into this tree, or repinned by this fixture.
The fixture is not a schema this repository owns: it is bytes from another tree, and the check beside it may only say what this repository does with them.
